definition: to walk with someone to keep them safe
description: In a sunny farmyard, a smiling young woman in a navy postal polo shirt, shorts, boots and sporty sunglasses holds out a bundle of letters by a wooden gate and then walks down the track towards the camera with the letters in her hand. A group of grey geese walks closely all around her, some flapping their wings, and a black and white collie trots behind. Two farm workers in overalls by a quad bike laugh and wipe their eyes, and a cat sits on the stone wall.
